scene_type: 2D (near-nadir top-down drone view of a football pitch; ground plane ~ image plane)
time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*fps)
units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale assumed
coordinates: image px, x right, y down. Tracks give raw (x,y) and drift-corrected frame-0 coords (x_stab,y_stab). Use x_stab,y_stab for motion.

camera.motion: static to within measurement (hovering drone). Slow drift relative to frame 0: max ~2.2 px translation, rotation <= 0.076 deg, scale change <= 0.025% over the whole clip; per-frame change < 0.1 px
files: camera_affine.csv (ECC affine frame0->frame i, per frame)
camera.view: looking straight down; pitch lines are almost exactly axis-aligned (right goal line x=1594 at y~200 vs 1596.5 at y~730: ~0.25 deg tilt); ground scale is uniform across the image (centre circle x/y radii 117.0/117.5 px)

player_A_light.description: person in light/white-orange clothing (light-coloured blob, orange top in late frames), starts at the LEFT of the right penalty spot; the one who kicks the ball
player_A_light.reference_point: intensity-weighted centre of the body blob (top-down view, so ~ the body centre over the ground); casts a long shadow toward lower-right that is excluded
player_A_light.extent_px: top-down body blob: length median 12.4 (p10 10.0, p90 15.8), width median 9.5, bbox ~11x12, area ~57 px. Not a standing height (seen from above).
player_A_light.occluded_frames: 115-117 and 174-180 (blob touches player B; pixels split by 2-means, centre less reliable ~±2 px)

player_B_dark.description: person in dark/black clothing (white limbs/shoes), starts just RIGHT-below the right penalty spot; chases the rolling ball and collects it at the end
player_B_dark.reference_point: intensity-weighted centre of the body blob
player_B_dark.extent_px: length median 13.9 (p10 12.2, p90 16.3), width median 10.2, bbox ~13x12, area ~60 px. Seen from above.

ball.hidden: frames 0-149: not separately visible (with/under player A); frame 286: lost where it reaches the penalty-area line (white line) next to player B
ball.reference_point: centre of the bright ball blob
ball.extent_px: diameter ~4-5 px (bbox median 4x4, area ~14 px); 5-6 px when blurred
ball.path: still at (1451-1453, 563-565) frames ~153-172; rolls down-left (image heading ~117-124 deg, i.e. dx<0, dy>0) frames 173-262; after the touch by B it moves left (heading ~-165 deg) frames 264-285

events.what: both players near the right penalty spot, nearly still
player A begins slow drift right (~0.3-0.7 px/frame) toward the penalty spot
player A turns and moves down-right (~1 px/frame)
player B starts moving (downward, then down-right)
ball first separately visible, just in front of (below) player A
ball at rest at ~(1451.5, 564) until frame 172
player A nearly stops beside the ball (~frames 156-166)
kick: player A's foot contacts the ball (ball blob elongated); ball moves from frame 173 (release)
players A and B touch/merge (174-180); then A goes back up, B runs down-left after the ball
player A nearly stationary at ~(1455,555) until ~213, then drifts right/down
player B reaches the ball (contact ~262-264); ball direction changes from down-left to left
last ball detection (1380.5,645.8), at the penalty-area line, at B's feet

static_objects_px_frame0.pitch_outline: line centres: left goal line x~286, right goal line x~1594 (top) to 1596.5 (bottom); top touchline y~104, bottom touchline y~940-942. Pitch length (goal line to goal line) ~1309 px, width (touchline to touchline) ~836 px
static_objects_px_frame0.right_penalty_area: x 1377.2 to goal line 1594 (depth ~217 px), y 258.3-783.7 (width ~525 px)
static_objects_px_frame0.right_penalty_spot: (1451.4, 522.2): ~143 px from the right goal line; looks like a bright glowing white spot
static_objects_px_frame0.left_penalty_spot: (431.8, 522.0): ~146 px from the left goal line
static_objects_px_frame0.penalty_arcs: right arc reaches x~1329 (left of penalty-area line 1377); left arc reaches x~553
static_objects_px_frame0.right_goal: white frame x 1597-1622 (depth incl. net frame ~26 px), y 470-570 (outer width between posts ~101 px)
static_objects_px_frame0.left_goal: white frame x 259-283 (~25 px deep), y 472-572 (~101 px wide)
static_objects_px_frame0.dark_object_by_right_goal: static dark round object (bag/ball?) at x~1596-1607, y~460-470 (~11 px), next to the top post of the right goal; does not move
static_objects_px_frame0.other: small training goals along top (y~35-45: x~590-635, 760-805, 855-925, 1075-1120, 1305-1380) and bottom (x~755-825, y~1025) edges, and beside the pitch; neighbouring pitch on the right (lines at x~1717 and goal at x~1697-1735, y~467-567); fence/walkway around the pitch

files.tracks/*.csv: frame,time_s,x,y (raw image px),x_stab,y_stab (frame-0 coords),bbox_x0..y1 (frame-0 coords),length_px,width_px (min-area-rect of mask),area_px,detected,occluded
files.camera_affine.csv: per-frame affine frame0->frame i, scale, rotation
files.bg_region.png: temporal-median background of region x1300-1650, y400-820 (frame-0 coords)
files.track_paths.png: track paths drawn on frame 0 (crop x1340-1500, y490-680, 4x); dots every 30 frames
